description: This Java source file defines the ShoppingCartController class for managing shopping cart functionalities in a Spring MVC web application, including adding, viewing, removing, and updating shopping cart items via AJAX endpoints and page rendering.

classes.name: ShoppingCartController
classes.description: Controller managing shopping cart functionalities, including adding, viewing, removing, and updating items for an e-commerce application built with Spring MVC.

methods.name: addShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to add an item to the shopping cart, managing both logged-in and anonymous users, and returning the updated shopping cart data.

methods.name: displayShoppingCart
methods.description: Displays the current shopping cart page for a logged-in user by retrieving the cart via session and optional customer data.

methods.name: displayShoppingCart
methods.description: Displays shopping cart identified by a specific code, suitable for direct access via URL, with appropriate session management.

methods.name: removeShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Handles removal of an item from the shopping cart via AJAX or direct request, updating the session and optionally the database.

methods.name: updateShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Processes AJAX requests to update quantities of multiple shopping cart items, returning success or failure status.
